rationale: The construction is internally consistent (signed accrual z-score times a non-negative fragility intensity, correct negative sign), but because the multiplier is strictly non-negative the ranking is still dominated by the Sloan accrual main effect, so much of any measured slope will be a rediscovery rather than a true interaction — worth testing only if benchmarked against the raw accrual signal.

This is a hard-threshold cosmetic variant of Signal 1 rather than a distinct economic claim, and zeroing out the majority of firms piles a large mass at exactly zero, which degenerates quintile breakpoints and makes the long-short spread depend on arbitrary tie-breaking rather than on the hypothesized covenant-region nonlinearity.

ADD(che, act) double-counts cash since che is already a component of act, and more seriously the deflator contains receivables and inventory whose changes are the numerator's own accrual components, creating a mechanical numerator-denominator link that makes any result hard to interpret as the claimed liquidity conditioning; it is also just a deflator swap on a known anomaly.

This proposes a genuinely different channel (accrual-quality/information risk rather than accrual level) interacted with a two-legged distress measure, the sign logic is coherent since both factors are non-negative and increase in badness, and the main caveat is coverage loss and possible overlap with published accrual-quality-priced-in-distressed-firms results, which should be checked against a standalone VOL benchmark.

Economically coherent and correctly signed, but it is mislabeled as conditional (it is a smooth product), lct appears on both sides creating partial mechanical dependence, and the base term is the textbook working-capital accrual, so the incremental content rests entirely on whether the inverse current ratio adds anything beyond a positive scaling.

SUB(ib/at, txt/at) is not a book-tax gap — it uses after-tax income and omits the statutory-rate grossing-up, so its dominant cross-sectional variation is simply profitability (ROA), which means the stated negative expected sign directly contradicts the well-documented positive profitability premium and the signal is internally inconsistent with its hypothesis.
